request: Analyze GSE263912 for PMID 39141732 (Remodeling p38 signaling in muscle controls locomotor activity via IL-15.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.accession_source: not named in the paper (S5.4.p1 says all data are in the paper/supplement); matched to the paper by content (tissue, diet, genotypes, RSEM + limma TMM pipeline, CPM>=1 in >=3 samples filter)
final.sample_inclusion: gastrocnemius of mice fed HFD for 6 weeks, fasted overnight; RIN > 8; each library = pool of two animals (S4.22.p1); 3 libraries per genotype
final.exercise_factor: none in the sequenced samples: all mice sedentary HFD-fed and fasted overnight (FIG5 A-C, S4.22.p1). Exercise appears only in non-sequencing experiments (treadmill IL-15 plasma ELISA, FIG5E; human biopsies, FIG1A; wheel/treadmill behaviour, FIG4)
final.primary_estimand: genotype effect (muscle p38alpha or p38alpha/gamma knockout vs control) on gastrocnemius expression in sedentary HFD-fed mice; not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: p38alphaMCK-KO vs control (S4.22.p2; paper: 15 secreted-protein DEGs at raw P < 0.05, S2.7.p1/S4.24.p1; total DEG count at FDR not reported)
p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO vs control (S4.22.p2; count not reported)
p38alphaMCK-KO vs p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO (S4.22.p2; count not reported)
final.normalization: TMM (limma pipeline), genes with CPM >= 1 in >= 3 samples (S4.22.p2)
final.paper_method: limma on RSEM expected counts, TMM normalization (S4.22.p2)
final.paper_results: Il15 up in p38alphaMCK-KO but not in p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO vs control (S2.7.p1, FIG5C); 15 secreted-protein DEGs in p38alphaMCK-KO

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The only RNA-seq in the paper (S4.22.p1-p2, FIG5 A-C) compares three muscle-specific genotypes in sedentary HFD-fed, overnight-fasted mice. No exercise arm, time point, or training status exists in the sequenced samples. Exercise enters the paper only through phenotyping and plasma IL-15 after treadmill running, which were not sequenced.

checks: GEO series GSE263912: gastrocnemius, mice fed HFD for 6 weeks, RIN > 8 (extract_protocol) = S4.22.p1
genotypes control / p38alphaMCK-KO / p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO, 3 each = FIG5 A-C groups
data_processing: RSEM + limma TMM, CPM >= 1 in >= 3 samples = S4.22.p2
contact CNIC Bioinformatics Unit = S4.22.p2 (CNIC Bioinformatics Unit)
paper does not name the accession (S5.4.p1)

ownership.reasoning: The paper names no GEO accession, but every described property of the sequencing experiment matches GSE263912. Minor discrepancy recorded: paper says GRCm38.76 and HiSeq2500; GEO says GRCm38.91 and Illumina MiSeq.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (HN_1..3, COW_1..3, KIC_1..3) sit inside the metadata title ('gastrocnemius, COW_1'); exact key match on that derived key. HN = p38alphaMCK-KO, COW = p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO, KIC = control per the genotype field.

final.paper_input: RSEM expected counts processed by limma/TMM (S4.22.p2); only the TMM-normalized CPM (pre-filtered CPM>=1 in >=3 samples) is deposited

matrix.reasoning: integer fraction 0, decimals, min 0.017, max 55154; GEO data_processing states 'TMM-normalized counts (CPM)'. Raw/expected counts are not deposited.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples: GSE263912 has only a genotype factor (control, p38alphaMCK-KO, p38alpha/gammaMCK-KO; 3 pooled libraries each) in sedentary HFD-fed, overnight-fasted mice (S4.22.p1, FIG5 A-C). The paper's RNA-seq estimand is a knockout effect, not an exercise effect; no metadata column codes exercise, training, or time after exercise.

candidates.value: geno AKO vs CTRL as an exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: a genetic knockout is not an exercise exposure; the paper itself does not frame it as one, and relabelling it would misstate the estimand

design.reasoning: Refused at design per the contract rule 'no exercise contrast in the sequenced samples'. The genotype contrasts are well defined (n=3 per arm) and could be analysed with limma on log2(CPM+1), but they do not answer the request.

discrepancies.impact: paper route would need limma on log2 CPM; moot because the design is refused
